description: nba-emu/hw-test (NanoBoyAdvance hardware tests, BSD-3-Clause), the 10 scored ROMs of cores/gba/tests/test_config.json rebuilt with a Veloce patch that reports every test_expect*() check as a VELOCE-RESULT/1 CHECK line plus one END line over the mGBA debug registers (channel mgba). GBA-3 of the test-ROM plan. ppu/bgpd and ppu/bgx are not rebuilt: they have no CPU-readable result and stay upstream binaries in visual_test_suites (see PROVENANCE.md).
license: BSD-3-Clause (Copyright 2021, fleroviux), see PROVENANCE.md; links the vendored mgba.c/mgba.h (MIT, tests/roms-src/include/devkitarm/vendor/PROVENANCE.md) and devkitPro's libgba
golden_gate_reason: Only dma/latch rebuilds byte-identically from the pinned source; the other nine shipped binaries were built by older devkitARM releases. Replaced by the instruction-window audit in PROVENANCE.md (verify_windows.py): every measured window of the patched build is instruction-for-instruction the shipped binary's, two of them because the patch pins them in asm. build.py still records golden_sha256/rebuilt_sha256 per ROM.

commands: for d in dma/latch dma/start-delay dma/force-nseq-access dma/burst-into-tears irq/irq-delay timer/start-stop timer/reload haltcnt bus/128kb-boundary ppu/status-irq-dma; do make -C $d clean >/dev/null && make -C $d || exit 1; done
